# CORE-SEC-03

**Is every path that carries untrusted content identified, and is that content validated before it is acted on?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | SEC: Security architecture |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `connectors.carries_untrusted_content` |

## Rule

Every connector with an actor, an external-system, or an element in a partially-trusted or untrusted zone at either end states carries_untrusted_content, whichever way the content flows. A pull from an outside source brings content in although the puller is the from end.

## Sources

- Threat Modeling Manifesto (`tmm`)
- OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 5.0.0 (2025) (`asvs`)
